ctx.x: Was that being Nookie Johnson? Did you know him? Johnson. And Willie, Willie Jackson. Willie Jackson. Nookie Johnson, Willie Jackson.

Those are two singers. This old man. That old man used to play bass. I can't think of his name. Just died recently? Oh no, he'd been dead. He was a bass player.
